title: vandellia micrantha
intro: Vandellia micrantha, commonly known as 'Tikli' or 'Gurhal', is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Vandellia micrantha include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
